init.help: Scaffold a consumer repo (wiring only -- no policies)

add.help: Install a policy or skill from a catalog and compile it

install.help: Build a chock.sh selection into one plugin for one agent (install --selection <file> [--client C])

remove.help: Remove an installed policy and resync

sync.help: Recompile + rewire so the repo matches its policies (--ci/--skills for extras)

check.help: Run every truth check: validate, verify, evals, matrix (--only to narrow; --history scans past commits; --floor, a preview, judges a pull request's merge result with its base's gates; it holds only as a required check the pull request cannot redefine, and judges committed content only)

status.help: Policy states and coverage (--only registry,log for more)

stop.help: Refuse every agent tool call, commit and push here until resume (--agent C for one client)

resume.help: Lift a stop: agents are judged by the policies again

doctor.help: Check each client's hooks on each route: present, current, and seen running (--client X)

incident.help: An ordered, redacted timeline from the local decision log (incident --since T [--until T] [--share])

witness.help: Export one client's redacted decision log for its agentseam evidence issue (witness export --client C)

bundle.help: Switch a member of an installed plugin bundle on or off (bundle on|off <id>, bundle status)

install-skills.help: Install bundled authoring skills into agent skill dirs (write mode; check via CI)

plugin.help: Package policies as installable plugins (plugin build [--format claude] [--check])

marketplace.help: Emit marketplace index files over a built plugin tree (marketplace build --dist <dir>)

gateway.help: Run the MCP gateway proxy (gateway run --repo . -- <server command>)

mcp.help: Serve the read-only chock_guidance MCP tool over stdio (mcp --repo .)

review.help: Produce or check reviewer evidence (review emit | review verify <file> | review require)

compliance.help: Generate a compliance coverage report (compliance report --framework owasp_asi)
